supersededOrAmbiguousIdentities.fullFinding: Assigned AOC form AOCCRSA3F-010122, revision 01/01/2022, is superseded. The current Arizona AOC forms index link resolves first to AOCCRSA3F-103023.docx, revision 10/30/2023, before redirecting to Microsoft authentication.

Assigned AOC form AOCCRSA4F-010122, revision 01/01/2022, is superseded. The current Arizona AOC forms index link resolves first to AOCCRSA4F-103023.docx, revision 10/30/2023, before redirecting to Microsoft authentication.

The publisher prints the parent as AOC CREM2F-071221 (without the assignment's hyphen after AOC) and publishes one three-page parent PDF. Pages 2-3 contain the continuation material; there is no separately published -CONT document.

The continuation is page 3 of the five-page AOCCRSL1F parent and is not standalone. The AOC landing's SharePoint target is named AOCCRSL1F-050825.docx, while Administrative Directive 2025-07, signed 05/08/2025, attaches a form printed AOCCRSL1F-050625. Both the component status and the 050825/050625 suffix conflict require a Captain decision.

The assigned 08/22/2024 Form 31(a) is not current. The official landing still resolves to an intervening AOCCR41FORM31A-010126.docx standalone, but Arizona Supreme Court matter R-26-0001 amended Form 31(a) effective upon filing on 08/27/2026. The adopted Form 31(a) specification in R-26-0001 controls.

No standalone -CONT document is published. The controlling R-26-0001 Form 31(a) is multi-page and tells filers that additional counts continue on a separate page, but it supplies no separately numbered continuation sheet or binary. The 2024 parent identity is also superseded by R-26-0001.

The assigned 08/22/2024 Form 31(b) is not current. The official landing still resolves to an intervening AOCCR41FORM31B-010126.docx standalone, but Arizona Supreme Court matter R-26-0001 amended Form 31(b) effective upon filing on 08/27/2026. The adopted Form 31(b) specification in R-26-0001 controls.

The assignment calls the Family Court source FORM-281. The current Delaware Judiciary index publishes it as form number 281, title Petition For Expungement of Adult Record, revision 11/26/2025. The binary could not be acquired because the download endpoint returned WAF rejection HTML.
